runtimeDivergences.reason: Canonical Dev must have a distinct installed launcher/visible identity and route normal runtime to WITCH_DEV_MAIN rather than silently executing Stable while appearing to be Dev. Tampermonkey identity must remain stable across versions so updates replace the existing Dev install instead of creating duplicates. Issue-scoped task branches may temporarily self-route for isolated validation, but must normalize before canonical integration.
acceptance: Canonical Tampermonkey @name is the fixed WITCH DOCK - DEV identity and @namespace remains stable.
Canonical userscript @version, runtime DEV_VERSION, manifest launcher version/build, and visible Dock title version remain synchronized.
Canonical update/download URLs, manifest URL, and manifest-loaded runtime URLs resolve to WITCH_DEV_MAIN.
A Dev bootstrap/channel-seam failure is visible rather than silently falling back to Stable.

runtimeDivergences.reason: Stage C architecture work on wd/10-modular-bootstrap moves bounded presentation ownership out of the Stable-derived monolith while preserving contracts. v1.3.6 externalized core CSS; Booth_Runtime_Bootstrap v0.1.2 repaired the cold-session Booth prerequisite and passed its native lifecycle gate; v1.3.7 adds a GitHub-owned About/Disclaimer module loaded/configured by the bounded bootstrap and replaces only the guarded legacy modal implementations with thin wrappers.
acceptance: Task launcher/manifest identify v1.3.7 / build 1.3.7-extracted-core-modals; Tampermonkey @name remains fixed WITCH DOCK - DEV.
witch-dock-styles remains v0.1.0 / build 0.1.0-extracted-core-css and the v1.3.6 CSS gate remains healthy.
booth-runtime-bootstrap remains v0.1.2 / build 0.1.2-session-cold-start; one native Booth script, no duplicate, native lifecycle ownership, 4K/8K/WebP ready, and no bootstrap error remain proven.
witch-dock-modals is v0.1.0 / build 0.1.0-extracted-about-disclaimer and is fetched as a bootstrap module through bounded requestText.
The modal module receives only script metadata plus the existing GitHub and Ko-fi URLs; raw GM_* privileges remain unexposed page-side.
The launcher finds exactly one guarded legacy modal block containing each of the six legacy modal functions exactly once and replaces only those implementations with wrappers to KWWitchDockModals.
About/Disclaimer preserve existing DOM ids/classes/content, mutual exclusion, close-button/overlay/Escape behavior, links, and version display; reopen creates no duplicate overlays.
Module loader remains 23/23 with zero failures and existing cache/order/enablement behavior is unchanged.
No storage, registration, drag/minimize, hotkey, undo/redo, bone-HUD, or unrelated feature lifecycle ownership moves in v1.3.7.
Checked-in Witch_Dock.user.js remains Stable-derived during this guarded migration seam; physical source deletion waits for the later true core split.
Before eventual integration to WITCH_DEV_MAIN, task-specific URLs are normalized to canonical Dev and revalidated.

notes: New Dev began directly from the Stable baseline above.
Governance/documentation files are intentionally Dev-specific and are not runtime divergences.
Every intentional runtime difference requires an open issue/task and this ledger.
Task-branch self-routing is temporary validation infrastructure, not canonical channel behavior.
